externalities-negative.alt: An externality graph with Price on the vertical axis and Quantity on the horizontal axis. D = MPB = MSB slopes down. S = MPC slopes up, and MSC lies above it by the external cost per unit. The market produces QM at price PM, where MPB = MPC. The efficient quantity QE, where MSB = MSC, is smaller and its price PE higher. The deadweight loss is the shaded triangle between MSC and MSB from QE to QM, pointing toward QE.

externalities-positive.alt: An externality graph with Price on the vertical axis and Quantity on the horizontal axis. D = MPB slopes down, and MSB lies above it by the external benefit per unit. S = MPC = MSC slopes up. The market produces QM at PM, where MPB = MPC; the efficient quantity QE, where MSB = MSC, is larger. The deadweight loss is the shaded triangle between MSB and MSC from QM to QE.
